name: examintel-mcp
description: Semantic search and study-plan generation over your own exam question papers.

data_directory.title: Project Data Folder
data_directory.description: Select your examintel-mcp project folder (the one containing data/pdfs and chroma_db — the same folder you run ingest.py in).

tools.name: search_topic
tools.description: Semantic search across indexed past exam papers for a subject and topic

tools.name: topic_frequency
tools.description: Rank recurring terms by how often they appear across indexed years

tools.name: generate_study_plan
tools.description: Generate a revision priority order based on topic frequency and days remaining
